programs.summary: Crypto-backed Visa card in the Avalanche ecosystem, offered and powered by Rain Liquidity. The reviewed U.S. cardholder agreement identifies Third National, Inc. as issuer under a Visa licence; current product disclosures state that card collateral remains owned and custodied by the user.

U.S.-scoped virtual prepaid Visa debit card inside Phantom Cash that spends the CASH stablecoin balance. Phantom identifies Lead Bank as issuer and Bridge Ventures LLC as program manager, with Bridge converting CASH to USD at payment time.

Bitget Wallet crypto payment card available across multiple regions, with Visa or Mastercard depending on the regional issuing partner. From August 2026 new applications for the legacy Bitget Card moved to Bitget Wallet while existing legacy cards continued to operate until expiry.

relations.scope_note: Avalanche Card's reviewed U.S. Cardholder Agreement identifies Third National / Third National, Inc. as issuer. This relation is not generalized to jurisdictions governed by other issuing partners.
Avalanche Card is offered and powered by Rain Liquidity; the U.S. agreement also identifies Rain Liquidity as service partner. No broader issuer role is assigned to Rain for the U.S. program.
Current Avalanche Card materials and the U.S. card agreement identify Visa as the payment network.
Phantom's U.S. open-access announcement identifies Lead Bank as issuer of the prepaid Visa debit card.
Phantom identifies Bridge Ventures LLC as Program Manager responsible for managing and operating the card on behalf of Lead Bank.
Phantom identifies the product as a prepaid Visa debit card usable wherever Visa is accepted.
Bitget Wallet documents Mastercard variants of the card, with network and issuing partner varying by region.
Bitget Wallet's Mainland China card help documentation identifies a partnership with Fiat24. This regional relation is not generalized to other Bitget Wallet Card markets.

events.title: Avalanche Card U.S. agreement documents Third National and Visa stack
events.description: The reviewed Avalanche Card U.S. Cardholder Agreement, last updated February 5, 2025, identifies Third National, Inc. as issuer under Visa and Rain Liquidity as service partner. The date is treated as an evidence milestone, not asserted as the public launch date.

events.title: Phantom opens Cash debit card access across eligible U.S. market
events.description: Phantom announced that starting March 31, 2026 eligible U.S. users could make purchases with the Phantom debit card anywhere Visa is accepted. The launch disclosure identifies Lead Bank as issuer and Bridge as program manager.

events.title: Bitget Wallet Card becomes destination for new Bitget card applications
events.description: Bitget moved new card applications to Bitget Wallet from August 1, 2026 while existing legacy Bitget Cards remained active. This records the new-application transition without claiming that existing cardholders were migrated or that the legacy card immediately shut down.
